claim_boundaries.annotation: No eligibility decision, sample, media, rubric approval, rater response, label, consensus, adjudication, usability decision or threshold exists.
claim_boundaries.authenticated: Exact published aggregate cell-receipt pointers, timing output pointers, compiler output pointers, and unjoined request identity populations only.
claim_boundaries.mapping: Request identities and cell pointers remain separate. No request-to-cell join is materialized or authenticated.
claim_boundaries.raw_PVC: No raw cell receipt, request inventory, timing sidecar, compiler bundle, fixture payload, media file or PVC byte was opened or rehashed.
claim_boundaries.release: No queue descriptor or confirmation cell was released.
claim_boundaries.science: No forecast error, skill, baseline, missingness bound, model comparison, resource qualification or confirmation result is inferred.

current_state_boundary.boundary: Historical published pointers do not establish current GM/PVC/queue/worker/GPU/child/reap/release-lock state or raw artifact availability.

historical_timing_scope.boundary: Pinned receipt metadata only; no raw timing output was opened and no current raw availability or broader timing coverage is inferred.

request_identity_population.boundary: The committed request identities and historical cell pointers are authenticated as separate populations. No request identity is joined to a cell; that mapping requires authorized raw inventory retrieval and replay.
